articles.title: Regulators invited Binance to seek new licenses after MiCA setback, co-CEO says
articles.snippet: Binance is exploring new licensing paths into Europe while continuing to expand its regulatory footprint in Asia, says co-CEO Richard Teng.

articles.title: AI is shortening the shelf life of crypto security audits, researchers warn
articles.snippet: Hackers have also been exploiting the codebases of defunct decentralized finance protocols, draining millions of dollars in customer funds.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Strategy Turns Net Seller
articles.snippet: Michael Saylor becomes a major Bitcoin seller. A memecoin gets "exploited" via governance. And Bernstein doubles down on a $150k BTC call.

articles.title: Solana Meme Coin Bonk Treasury Drained of $20 Million in 'Malicious' Governance Attack
articles.snippet: The Bonk DAO wallet was exploited for roughly $20 million worth of the prominent dog-themed meme coin on Solana.
